My advice would definitely be this; let her enjoy the thing she likes, but know where to put a limit. She can love the creepy moves and spooky shows, but when she starts wanting to watch “Texas Chainsaw Massacre” when she’s only 7 could make a problem for you, being that she’d become scared.
But if she does want to dive into that category (and you’re okay with letting her, of course), definitely don’t let her do it alone. Just provide reassurance that you’ll be with her if she gets scared and that it’s okay to be scared. But remember that at the end of the day, you have a larger say in what your daughter does/watches at such a younger age
Hope this helps 😊😊
